newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soymeal ends higher on China buying talk.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soymeal ends higher on China buying talk.

text.p: CBOT December soymeal closed higher on talk China bought 50,000 tonnes of U.S. soymeal and was seeking another 50,000 tonnes, traders said.
Soyoil was lower on soymeal/soyoil spreading, they said.
Merrill Lynch Futures bought 400 lots of December soymeal, Farmers Commodities Corp bought 300 March and Refco Inc bought 400 January, traders said.
Position squaring was noted before the release Tuesday of USDA's November crop production report, the traders said.
The market also was evening up before the weekend and prior to the release late Friday of an updated Commodity Futures Trading Commission Commitments of Traders report.
Soymeal closed $1.80 per ton higher to $0.40 lower, with December up $1.80 at $229.60. Soyoil was 0.04 to 0.11 cent per lb lower, with December down 0.10 at 22.99.
Soymeal futures volume was estimated at 21,000 contracts, compared with 25,934 Thursday, according to the CBOT. Soyoil futures volume was estimated at 18,000 contracts, below the 22,979 Thursday.
